verdict.rationale: Cooley's labor and employment practice page documents that the firm represents companies and individuals in noncompete and trade secret litigation and pursues such claims. That directly covers the employee-mobility and trade-secret-litigation parts of the story, but the evidence is a single line with no matter volumes, case examples or dedicated trade-secret practice description. The mutual NDA template is a form, not evidence of confidentiality-program counseling. Missing for 10: documented counseling on trade-secret confidentiality programs, a dedicated trade-secret practice description with matter counts or representative cases, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm documents trade-secret protection work — confidentiality programs, employee-mobility disputes, or trade-secret litigation

citations.quote: Successfully representing companies and individuals in noncompete and trade secret litigation – and pursuing such claims for our clients
